e law is very likely separable.
- The time part is smooth and decreasing, but a pure sinusoid in t fits only to about 3e-6.
- The spatial part has a steep rise at small x (about −8.9 at x≈0.2), a peak near x≈1.4, and a decline toward x≈2.7. No single combination of standard terms I tried matched it.
